scope: Standing Canadian War Museum on Vimy Place in Ottawa, including its walkable grass roofs, low exposed concrete, angled eastern curtain wall, pedestrian terrace and copper-clad Regeneration Hall fin.

originalReview.notes: Wide view from the southeast with permanent angled concrete, east curtain glazing, copper fin and its small dark Morse apertures. Soil piles and unfinished roof finishes are disregarded.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact Qualla original was screened first and depicts only an unrelated interior exhibition. The first author release and migration record were verified for the supplemental native photograph by RealGrouchy.
